crossRefs.note: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near…
and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
translations.bsb: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
translations.kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
translations.asv: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
